svg.title: Projection neuron responses by glomerulus for 3-octanol and 4-methylcyclohexanol, flies against the model, and the APL sweep's block effect against its equalization
svg.text: The model's projection neurons answer only where receptor input reaches; flies' imaged ones answer more widely
Left, middle: the model answers in the glomeruli the receptor input drives (red) and nowhere else (rings); flies' imaged PNs answer in more, but in the faint ones
recordings find no firing or the imaging copies a neighbour. Right: an APL strong enough for flies' block effect saturates and stops favouring 4-methylcyclohexanol.
